files.title: File:Fireboat 'Chief Seattle' at Fishermen's Terminal January 2019 - 01.jpg
files.author: Joe Mabel
files.caption: Fireboat Chief Seattle hauled out of the water & undergoing some kind of work at Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, Washington, January 2019. Presumably nothing very major, since the boat was completely retrofitted in 2013. Seen from South Ship Canal Trail.
